spiritual_reading:
# Spiritual Translation

** ¶1:**

They ask : Teach concerning that small portion of spiritual life and wisdom which proceeds from the three receiving degrees of the mind that encompass the whole of the human spirit — how that life asc ends from within them .

**¶2:** The infl owing tru ths from the Divine, which are received into the understanding, illuminate and pass in ward through every open faculty of perception , through every point of entry , degree by degree through the successive levels of the mind — from the ou termost natural plane toward the interior spiritual and celestial planes .

**¶3:**

For in each degree of the mind, the fac ulties of reception open in complete fullness — toward every quarter of the understanding — and these fac ulties look downward toward the containing forms of the natural mind. Because of this, the illumin ating tru ths of wisdom enter through these fac ulties of reception and shine upon the natural plane , and draw out through them whatever wisdom , and whatever supporting interior connection between higher and lower, remains held captive there.

**¶ 4:** From the natural plane, what is drawn out is distributed upward through the successive degrees of the mind. It is further purified at each level of consciousness . One part — whatever is genu inely good and true — is cleansed and raised entirely into union with those who possess spiritual life. But the other part — whatever is of falsity and self -love and res ists purification — is entirely separated and cast down ward.

---

* Note : The " little pillar" is uncertain in the manuscript . I read it as the sl ender interior connection — a living thread of correspondence — linking the natural degree to the spiritual, through which capt ive good can be extracted up ward. This acc ords with Swedenborg's teaching that even in the lowest natural states, some remn ant of heav enly order persists as a channel for redem ption.*

So, due to this, the [light of the] rays shall go in through these openings and it shines on [that] place, and pulls through them the light and the little pi[llar that ex]ists there.

From that place [it] shall be poured [out to the] firmaments. It shall also be clarified in these firmaments [, and of what is clarified,] a part there is cleansed and it is [all] taken up with the living ones. However, its other part [, that which is of the darkness and the mixture,] shall all [be cast] down.
